interface.name: kywc_capture_manager_v1

description.summary: manager to inform clients and begin get capturing

interface.description: This object is a manager which offers requests to start capturing from a source.

request.name: capture_output
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire output.

request.name: capture_workspace
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire workspace in one output.

request.name: capture_toplevel
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire toplevel.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: delete this object, used or not

request.description: Destroys the frame. This request can be sent at any time by the client.

event.name: failed
event.description: This event indicates that the attempted frame copy has failed. After receiving this event, the client should destroy the object.

event.name: cancelled
event.description: Sent if the compositor cancels the frame because the source has gone. Upon receiving this event, the client should destroy this object.

event.name: buffer
event.description: Provides information about buffer parameters that need to be used for this frame.

request.name: release_buffer
request.description: Mark the buffer is not used by client. This request is sent after buffer event.

arg.name: want_buffer
arg.summary: request send buffer event when buffer is changed
